item.title: Ebony Alert Canceled for 13-Year-Old Boy in Gardena
item.description: A 13-year-old boy who went missing in Gardena has been located and the Ebony Alert activated in response to his disappearance has been canceled, authorities said Saturday. item.title: Man Killed in Hit-and-Run Collision on 5 Freeway in Castaic
item.description: A man killed in a hit-and-run collision on the Golden State (5) Freeway in Castaic was publicly identified Saturday, as the investigation continued. Alejandro Covarrubias, 22, died at the scene from blunt force injuries in an accident, the Los Angeles County Office of Medical Examiner said.
